Name: (CP) Difficult Community Center
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][size=1][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]﻿
[/size][/center][center][color=#ff0000][size=5]If you want to play with this mod, it has to be in a new game, and YOU DO NOT HAVE TO ACTIVATE THE "REMIXED BUNDLES" OPTION AS IT MAY GENERATE ERRORS[/size][/color][/center][center]I consider that the community center is a good challenge in the game for newer or not so expert players, but for someone who plays with mods or is an expert in the game, the community center loses quality, that is why I made this mod!
I never found a mod from the community center that satisfied me, since it was either outdated, or it was excessively complicated, I never found a middle ground (I'm sorry if I offend any creators of those mods) so I tried with great care to create a middle point.
The mod is 100% studied so that it can be completed in year 2, just as ConcernedApe thought (or at least that's what I think)
[color=#93c47d][size=5]List of changes: [/size][/color]

- [b]7 new bundles[/b] were added by default (belonging to the game if you choose the remixed Bundles option) distributed in the different sections of the community center 

- [b]Existing lots have been "improved"[/b] to make them more challenging

- Many of the [b]rewards were improved[/b] to make the mod fairer and so that the community center was not a garbage can of valuable items

Here is a detailed list of all the changes I made to each of the bundles and what the new ones contain.
[color=#ffd966][size=1]The bundle rewards are not listed, as I want it to be a surprise, but don't worry, there are no exaggerated rewards if that's what you think.[/size][/color]
[quote]﻿Pantry
